title_zh: 区分会员表中的住址与邮寄地址

scenario.label_zh: 核对住址表中实际居住与邮寄地址的区别
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清表格的现住址栏与邮寄栏并决定分别填写

context_zh: 虚构体育俱乐部会员登记练习。申请人 Nico 与职员 Sara 只解释该示例表格，不涉及政府居留资格。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: The form asks for a residential address, but I usually receive post at my parents' house.

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: For this club form, that first field means where you currently reside.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: So I should put my flat as my current residence?

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: Yes. There's a separate field below it for the address where you want letters sent.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: I'll enter the flat first and my parents' address in the postal field.

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: That will keep the two purposes clear.
